interpretation: The only noncompetitive terminal branch combines higher budget, lower sociality, and a non-PA network.
All other terminal branches are classified as competitive.
Lower-sociality profiles are classified as noncompetitive.
Higher sociality is insufficient when responsiveness to social information is low.
Social conditions are favorable, but low uncertainty limits the value of social information.
The competitive branch combines sufficient sociality, social influence, and uncertainty.
